description: Exploratory paired smoke of two alternative standard-controller signals against the recommended W20 window: cert-gated sample-and-hold (updates only when a certified EB is applied) and cert-void backfill (a no-cert Ranking Block enters the window as a third of an empty EB, 4,000,000 B / 3,166,377,816 exunits, instead of its own capacity). Urgent controller stays W5; everything else fixed at S=.75/U=.50, D16, half-RB threshold, K10. Five paired seeds across the five headline loads; directional only, not confirmatory evidence.
